canada.title: Mortgage delinquency rate up 31% in Q3, driven by Ontario and B.C.: Equifax report
canada.summary: A new report suggests there's growing stress among homeowners, with some struggling to keep up with monthly mortgage payments as interest rates rise again.

canada.title: Largest emissions spike in decade further sets back climate goals in Toronto area
canada.summary: A more polluting energy grid and rising demand for gas heating during a cold winter drove the largest annual spike in planet-warming emissions in at least a decade across the GTHA.

canada.title: Medicine Hat residents push back against location of proposed homeless shelter
canada.summary: Some residents argue the suggested location for a community hub and overnight shelter operated by The Mustard Seed could have negative consequences for homeowners and businesses in the area.

canada.title: Yukon Energy fires contractor building grid-scale battery, cites project delays
canada.summary: Texas-based SunGrid Solutions was hired by Yukon Energy in 2022 to build the grid-scale battery in Whitehorse. Yukon Energy said at the time the project was expected to be operational the following year.

canada.title: Emissions are another reason for an environmental review of EverWind’s hyperscale data centre
canada.summary: Since EverWind will need to use diesel generators, there will be greenhouse gas emissions. This should be reason enough to call for an impartial, balanced environmental review.

canada.title: Changes to inspection rules at food plants putting safety at risk: union
canada.summary: A federal union is warning about risks to food safety as the government cuts back on inspections at meat plants.

canada.title: Building water bombers or growing crops? This Alberta county has cast its vote
canada.summary: An Alberta farmer who used to rent 600 hectares of cropland west of Strathmore, Alta., is now reckoning with the land being turned into De Havilland's new aircraft manufacturing and commercial site, which will build coveted water bombers, but also take the place of some of the province's most productive soil.

canada.title: Can the B.C. Conservatives actually repeal SOGI 123 in schools? What you need to know
canada.summary: An education professor says the province actually has limited powers in what it can do about the sexual orientation and gender identity (SOGI) teaching resource, which will remain available for teachers and schools to use, and there's much misinformation about it.

canada.title: Parents of Regina boy killed in carbon monoxide leak 'speechless' to learn charges laid against building owner
canada.summary: The City of Regina said last week it's proceeding with regulatory charges against the owner of the apartments where a boy died from carbon monoxide poisoning. His parents are preparing to face the building's owner for the first time.

canada.title: After 15 years and 2 fires, Beauval, Sask., receives funding for new community complex
canada.summary: The federal government has announced funding to build the NorthWest Regional Recreation, Event and Emergency Protection Complex in Beauval, Sask. The community lost its arena in a fire in 2011.

canada.title: Yukon gov't to review school worksheet about 'positive aspects' of residential schools
canada.summary: The Yukon Department of Education says it will review its Grade 10 curriculum after concerns were raised about a worksheet given to students asking about "positive aspects" of residential schools.

canada.title: Montreal touts aerospace, AI in bid to host NATO defence bank
canada.summary: The Defence, Security and Resilience Bank is expected to launch next year with about 50 employees, growing to as many as 700 within a decade.

canada.title: N.B. cadet parent thankful government heard outcry and restored funding
canada.summary: One New Brunswick family involved in the cadet program is feeling thankful after the federal government reversed its decision to halt most cadet training until the end of Mach.

canada.title: Manitoba wildfire response in 2025 hampered by equipment shortages and fatigue among staff, report concludes
canada.summary: Manitoba was unprepared for the disastrous 2025 wildfire season and needs to devote more money, staff and equipment to ensure it can respond to all manner of emergencies, a new report says.

canada.title: Man sues Winnipeg police, saying 'unlawful' arrest left him with 'grievous' injuries
canada.summary: A man suing the city, the Winnipeg Police Service and multiple officers says he was significantly injured during an "unlawful" arrest.

canada.title: Anti-immigration group’s tour of the Maritimes draws criticism
canada.summary: The Dominion Society made stops in Charlottetown, Fredericton and Halifax trying to attract new members. Some local residents say there’s no room in the Maritimes for the group’s message of division.

canada.title: Should Nova Scotia adopt a bell-to-bell ban on cellphones in schools?
canada.summary: Opposition MLAs and a national advocacy group are calling on the Nova Scotia government to ban the use of cellphones in schools, taking its current policy a step further. But the education department says while it's monitoring other jurisdictions, there are no changes in the works.

canada.title: Between groceries and her sensor, this mom with diabetes is making tough choices
canada.summary: Mandi Buckle says between insurance and the rising cost of living, she’s had to do without medical devices essential to managing her Type 1 diabetes and has paid thousands of dollars to cover care.
